name: receiptdrop
description: Search ReceiptDrop receipts and generate reimbursement packages from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Find receipts and prepare reimbursement files.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to your ReceiptDrop account to search receipts, confirm which expenses to reimburse, run Generate, and download the resulting files for browser upload.
